HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Sewing Tools, Equipment and Materials 3.2 Textile Fibres 3.3 Clothing Constructi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Sewing Tools, Equipment and Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Textile Fibres 3.3 Clothing Construction Processes: Stitches 3.4 Clothing Constr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Textile Fibres and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
